scope: laterally uniform, small-strain, coaxial plane-strain column with prescribed temperature, lithostatic vertical stress and evolving raw plastic history; returns transmitted resistance for a supplied state; not localisation, rupture, necking, breakup, finite strain or calibration

provenance.rheology: ASPECT cookbooks/continental_extension/continental_extension.prm (main branch, retrieved 2026-09-27): dislocation-creep prefactors, stress exponents, activation energies and volumes already in ASPECT's invariant SI convention; densities 2700/2900/3300 kg/m3; cohesion 20 MPa; internal friction angle 30 degrees; gravity 9.81 m/s2
provenance.weakening: same file: 'plastic weakening with plastic strain only', interval 0.5 to 1.5 of ASPECT's accumulated deviatoric second-invariant strain at yielding points, cohesion and friction-angle factors 0.25; converted here to raw engineering plastic shear [1.0, 3.0]
provenance.inherited_history: authored laterally uniform replacement of the cookbook's random initial plastic strain '0.5 + rand_seed(1)' in the central 100 km of its upper 50 km (mean 1.0, engineering 2.0); zero below 50 km depth
provenance.temperature: authored piecewise-linear profile retained from i01_column_v1 (273/633/893/1613 K at 0/20/40/100 km depth); the 1013 K breakpoint at 50 km lies on the same line
provenance.authored: axial rate, plastic viscosity (explicit physical regularisation), grain size, zero pore pressure, the homogeneous/closed-form/refusal fixtures and all tolerances are authored control inputs, not calibrated defaults
provenance.diagnostic_only: heat capacity 750 J/kg/K and conductivity 2.5 W/m/K from the same ASPECT file are used only for a reported heating/conduction estimate; they never feed back

representation.geometry: laterally uniform column; coaxial plane-strain pure shear; material depth coordinates; small strain
representation.vertical_stress: lithostatic from supplied layer densities below a free, unloaded surface
representation.temperature: prescribed and fixed at material points; no conduction, heating or advection feedback
representation.pore_pressure: supplied and fixed at material points
representation.history: raw engineering plastic shear per material point; local weakening input; never overwritten
